result.scope: UI-only synthetic events and real RNA; recorded draw functions. Output waveform math, hover lifecycle and opaque pad checks included. No render/regression suite or desktop GPU test.

behavior: At most one highlighted pencil per Shader or Compositor editor across Grade nodes and Stack entries.
Clicking a different pencil selects its own node and switches the diagram target.
Sidebar toggles and diagram close buttons update Grade and Stack pencil highlights.
Inactive retained Stack targets reopen on pencil clicks.
Showing or hiding an empty Grade diagram does not allocate shared Grade data.
limitations: Buck2 is unavailable in this runtime; authoring checks do not satisfy its release gate.
Headless native CPU and registered operator checks; desktop pointer interaction and GPU rendering were not checked.
Grading math, LUT grids and previous precision/performance reports are unchanged; they were not remeasured.
